events.text:
The trader cannot cross the 6 water cells (17–22 on row 12) by walking, and there are only four crystals. So I move the magic mirror to (24,12) and use it to teleport crystals and the trader across the gap. Every cell of the plan follows from the map and the rules as read, but I have not run it through the checker.

**How the mirror helps.** With the mirror at (24,12), a thing at (24,12+k) on its south face reappears at (24-k,12). A crystal at (24,16) lands at (20,12), and one at (24,17) lands at (19,12). Both fall into the water and sink there, becoming floor. The trader standing at (24,16) lands on (20,12), supported by the sunk crystal. From (20,12) the trader's own west face line makes `X` swap it back to (24,16).

**Plan.**
1. Push crystal #3 down column 24 to (24,17). Push #5 down to (24,16). Push the mirror north twice, then west to (24,12).
2. Press `X` twice. #5 sinks at (20,12) and #3 sinks at (19,12).
3. Bring #4 to (24,17) and hop it onto (19,12). It rests on the sunk crystal at layer 0.
4. Hop the trader to (20,12), then push #4 west. It sinks at (18,12).
5. Hop the trader back to the island with `X`. Bring #6 down column 24 to (24,17) and hop it to (19,12).
6. Hop the trader to (20,12) again, then walk west pushing #6. It stops at (18,12) on the sunk crystal, then sinks at (17,12). Continue west to the door at (14,12).

The trader pushes one crystal at a time, so the setup pushes are done one crystal at a time. Crystals pushed over sunk cells stay at layer 0 until they reach open water. Whenever I press `X` for a crystal, the trader stays out of the mirror's two lines of sight so the mirror picks the crystal.
